test_title: SSC Selection Post 2024 (Higher Secondary Level) Official Paper (Held On: 25 Jun, 2024 Shift 2)
subject: general
question: Which of the following is NOT correct about the Prime Minister of India?

options.text: He is the principal communicator between the President and the Council of Ministers.
He is the Head of the Government.
He and his ministers are collectively responsible to the Upper House of the Parliament.
He recommends the name of persons who can be appointed as ministers by the President.

solution:
The correct answer is __**He and his ministers are collectively responsible to the Upper House of the Parliament**__.
